b2-nyelvujitas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Language of the Diet
b2-nyelvujitas-01.scenario: At a history evening in Pest, a visitor named Katalin asks you what language the Hungarian Diet used and what Joseph II ordered about it in 1784.
b2-nyelvujitas-01.prompt: Tell Katalin what language the Diet used and what Joseph II ordered.
cues: Say what the language of legislation was
Say what the ruler ordered and why
b2-nyelvujitas-01.target: A törvényhozás nyelve a latin volt. II. József a birodalom hatékonyabb kormányzása érdekében elrendelte a latin nyelv felváltását.
b2-nyelvujitas-01.english: The language of legislation was Latin. In the interest of governing the empire more effectively, Joseph II ordered the replacement of the Latin language.
b2-nyelvujitas-01.canDo: I can say what language the Hungarian Diet used and what Joseph II ordered about it in 1784.

b2-nyelvujitas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Master of Széphalom
b2-nyelvujitas-02.scenario: At a literary evening, a student named Márta asks you how Kazinczy could lead Hungarian literature from far-away Széphalom.
b2-nyelvujitas-02.prompt: Tell Márta how Kazinczy led literary life from Széphalom.
cues: Say what he used to reach other writers
b2-nyelvujitas-02.target: Kazinczy a levelezése révén irányította az irodalmi életet Széphalomról.
b2-nyelvujitas-02.english: Kazinczy led literary life from Széphalom through his letters.
b2-nyelvujitas-02.canDo: I can say how Ferenc Kazinczy led Hungarian literature from Széphalom through his letters.

b2-nyelvujitas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Pamphlet War
b2-nyelvujitas-03.scenario: At a lecture on Hungarian literature, a listener named Dani asks you what the dispute between Orthologists and Neologists produced.
b2-nyelvujitas-03.prompt: Tell Dani what the two sides published against each other.
cues: Say what the Orthologists published and when
b2-nyelvujitas-03.target: Az ortológusok 1813-ban gúnyiratot adtak ki, Kölcsey és Szemere pedig 1815-ben szellemes vitairatban felelt rá.
b2-nyelvujitas-03.english: In 1813 the Orthologists published a lampoon, and in 1815 Kölcsey and Szemere replied to it in a witty polemical essay.
b2-nyelvujitas-03.canDo: I can explain the pamphlet war between the Orthologists (Mondolat, 1813) and the Neologists (Felelet a Mondolatra, 1815).

b2-nyelvujitas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How a Word Was Made
b2-nyelvujitas-04.scenario: In a school language club, a pupil named Zsófi asks you how the word anyag was made.
b2-nyelvujitas-04.prompt: Tell Zsófi how the word anyag came into being.
cues: Say which word it came from
b2-nyelvujitas-04.target: Az anyag szót az anya főnévből szóképzéssel hozták létre a latin materia magyar megfelelőjeként.
b2-nyelvujitas-04.english: The word anyag was created from the noun anya by derivation, as the Hungarian equivalent of Latin materia.
b2-nyelvujitas-04.canDo: I can say how a word from the language reform, such as anyag, was made.

b2-nyelvujitas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: 1825 and 1844
b2-nyelvujitas-05.scenario: On a school history day, a pupil named Gergő asks you what Széchenyi did in 1825 and what the law of 1844 decided.
b2-nyelvujitas-05.prompt: Tell Gergő what Széchenyi pledged in 1825 and what the law of 1844 decided.
cues: Say what Széchenyi offered and for what
Say what the law of 1844 made Hungarian
b2-nyelvujitas-05.target: Széchenyi István egyévi jövedelmét ajánlotta fel a Magyar Tudós Társaság megalapítására. Az 1844. évi II. törvénycikk elfogadásával a magyar vált az ország hivatalos államnyelvévé.
b2-nyelvujitas-05.english: István Széchenyi offered one year's income for the founding of the Hungarian Learned Society. With the adoption of Act II of 1844, Hungarian became the country's official state language.
b2-nyelvujitas-05.canDo: I can tell what Széchenyi pledged in 1825 and what Act II of 1844 decided about Hungarian.

b2-nyelvujitas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From 1784 to 1844
b2-nyelvujitas-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a school project on the language reform, a teacher, Mrs Hajdú, asks you to sum up in two sentences how Hungarian became the language of state.
b2-nyelvujitas-consolidation.prompt: Sum up for Mrs Hajdú what the reformers did and what the law of 1844 decided.
cues: Say how the reformers enlarged the vocabulary
Say what the law of 1844 decided
b2-nyelvujitas-consolidation.target: A nyelvújítók az új szavak megalkotása révén bővítették a szókincset. Az 1844. évi II. törvénycikk elfogadásával a magyar hivatalos államnyelvvé vált.
b2-nyelvujitas-consolidation.english: The reformers enlarged the vocabulary by creating new words. With the adoption of Act II of 1844, Hungarian became the official state language.
b2-nyelvujitas-consolidation.canDo: I can retell the history of the Hungarian language reform from 1784 to 1844 in a few sentences.
